description: The fileUid of a Linear row binding in a Session 51 (webFiles.bindings.linearSeqs[i].fileUid, the row's File card): a non-empty string, kept as written, or left out. Both Session readers apply this one rule: the Web (services/session-resource-backing.js webFileBindingFaults, which drops a refused value with a Load repair row) and Python (gbdraw/session_io.py _validate_web_file_bindings, which refuses the Session). Read by tests/web/linear-file-card-identity.test.mjs and tests/test_session_linear_file_cards.py.
